Read-only view of the current circuit state of cb.Create a breaker in closed state; invalid option values are clamped to defaults.Named-argument convenience wrapper around the options-based constructor.Whether a request may proceed; an open circuit allows probes only after the timeout elapses.Report a successful request, closing the circuit after enough half-open successes.Report a failed request, opening the circuit once consecutive failures reach the threshold.Restore the breaker to a fresh closed state and clear all counters.Generic 503 body for a request rejected by an open circuit. Intentionally omits the circuit name so internal labels are not leaked to clients.Middleware that gates requests through the breaker; rejected requests receive a 503 with Retry-After.

Procs

proc circuitBreakerMiddleware(cb: CircuitBreaker): AsyncMiddleware {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}

Gate requests through cb; requests rejected by an open circuit receive 503 + Retry-After. The 503 body is intentionally generic (no circuit name) so internal infrastructure labels are not leaked to clients.

WARNING: Not thread-safe — do not share cb across threads.

proc isAllowed(cb: CircuitBreaker): bool {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Returns true if the request should be allowed. csClosed: always. csHalfOpen: up to successThreshold concurrent probes. csOpen: only after timeoutMs has elapsed (transitions to half-open on first probe).

Named-argument convenience wrapper around the options-based constructor. 
proc newCircuitBreaker(options: CircuitBreakerOptions): CircuitBreaker {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Creates a breaker in csClosed. Invalid option values are clamped to defaults (failureThreshold 5, successThreshold 2, timeoutMs 30000). 
proc recordFailure(cb: CircuitBreaker) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Reports a failed request. In csClosed, failureThreshold consecutive failures open the circuit; in csHalfOpen, a single failure re-opens it. 
proc recordSuccess(cb: CircuitBreaker) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Reports a successful request. In csHalfOpen, successThreshold successes close the circuit; in csClosed, the failure counter resets. 
proc reset(cb: CircuitBreaker) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Restores the breaker to a fresh csClosed state. 
proc state(cb: CircuitBreaker): CircuitState {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],

Read-only view of the current state. Change it only via recordSuccess/recordFailure/reset.
